facts.fact: Moyna 向 Clement 与 Alys 报告 bodykeeping hall 的发现：两名死者心脏周围是相同的魔法，而 burnout 的感觉不同；她还被 Captain Thoury 当场抓到
facts.anchor: identical magic around the hearts of the two victims

facts.fact: Thoury 想让 Moyna 长期替 gendarmerie 诊断死者；Moyna 说她已 bonded 到 Camar，必须先做满五年再回来，且 Greteford 已替她付了五年学费
facts.anchor: I’d have to do my five years there, and then come back

facts.fact: Estiene 最后一个到场，戴着珍珠与金耳饰；Jehan 的玩笑落空，Estiene 完全不看他
facts.anchor: He wore pearls and gold in his ears.

facts.fact: 第四位病人 Urzula 是 Tatranca 中部的军队 movement-mage；症状已恶化六个月，手脚会痉挛，她一位姑母有类似病却从未治好
facts.anchor: Her symptoms had been worsening for the past six months

facts.fact: Estiene 诊断出血、肌肉、甲状腺都受累，判断是 harper’s flail；他自称只是房里第三强，仍主动当 anchor
facts.anchor: I might be only the third strongest in the room

facts.fact: Alys 在 support 位上发抖，手按喉咙，迅速退出 array；Clement 改让 Alys 与 Moyna 去规划血液的每周疗程，由 Jehan 接手支撑 Estiene，右手做完后又开始右脚，剩三分钟时叫停
facts.anchor: she put her free hand to her throat, then stepped quickly out of the array

facts.fact: 考后一名一年级女生告诉 Alys：Grand Exam 前夜 Konrad Omeyer 一直关在自己房里学习，全程由一年级生 Lizette Roy 陪着，所以 Konrad 大概不是凶手
facts.anchor: Konrad Omeyer had been shut up in his own room studying the night before the Grand Exam

facts.fact: Alys 邀请三人参加 Lantern Night：不是家里的宴会，而是她为四人预订 North Tower 屋顶办的自己的派对，备了食物和酒
facts.anchor: I reserved us the roof of the North Tower.
